mn20:3.1: The word _nimitta_ means “focus of attention” - that is, whatever one is currently directing the mind towards.
mn20:8.13: This final line is technically in the past tense, however that clashes grammatically with the prior line which is in the future tense, and the preceding lines which are referring to a hypothetical future scenario. Accordingly the translation here is written in the future tense to match the content in the rest of the paragraph. It is probable that this last line contains a transmission error, and the original version had a slightly different final line.
